about_the_game:
🎵 Official Soundtrack — Violet 🎵


Dive into the emotional chaos and haunting beauty of Violet with this Official Soundtrack, featuring an unforgettable collection of atmospheric, melancholic, and intense tracks that capture the essence of survival, loss, and the twisted legacy of the Markwell family.

From the soft echoes of memories long buried to the thundering terror of the unknown, each composition was designed to mirror the fragile line between love and madness as Daniella Markwell, Hisoka Ayumi, Fumihiro Akio, and Catherine Markwell face their own inner demons.

🩸 Features

• Over 77 original tracks composed exclusively for the world of Violet
• Includes unreleased and alternate versions never heard in the main game
• Perfect for writing, reflecting, or reliving the horror once more

📍 About the Music

Every note carries the weight of tragedy — a symphony of despair and hope intertwined. From the echoing halls of Broken Paradise to the desolate silence of Siren’s Well, this soundtrack embodies the emotional intensity and psychological depth that define Violet’s world.

🕯️ Warning

This soundtrack contains emotionally heavy themes, distorted ambience, and moments of psychological tension. Listener discretion is advised.

Even in silence... the echoes of Violet remain.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence. Full Nudity in some specific Outfits and abuse of Legal Drugs.
